nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 fixed the allowlist drift in the firewall substrate: ALLOWED_DOMAINS, dnsmasq --ipset directives, runbook domain table, and test REQUIRED_HOSTS are now a single source of truth (7 entries each: api.anthropic.com, claude.ai, platform.claude.com, github.com, registry.npmjs.org, raw.githubusercontent.com, objects.githubusercontent.com). The test now parses --ipset domain args (not just ALLOWED_DOMAINS) per F-02, and a new cross-set drift test catches any future divergence. The runbook cross-check command also shows both the --ipset and ALLOWED_DOMAINS views. All 18 firewall tests pass. All remaining stories in prd.json are passes:true. The next action is /cam-review.

officialDocsValidated.summary: dnsmasq --ipset domain matching confirmed inclusive: --ipset=/github.com/set covers github.com AND all *.github.com subdomains (same rules as --address, full-label matching). The design assumption (github.com covers *.github.com, no separate *.github.com entry needed) is correct per official docs.
